name: GCC Genesis I Simple Pass/Fail Verification Policy
purpose: Authorize only objective 10 GCC payments for valid GCC Genesis I discovery-client submissions. No ranking, finalist judgment, or subjective best-submission decision is used.

authority_model.independence_requirement: Each verifier independently checks the same objective evidence bundle. Two valid independent attestations are required.

economics.selection_rule: First 10 unique submissions that pass every objective qualification gate are eligible. No ranking is performed.

canonicalization.description: Recursively sort object keys lexicographically, preserve array order, serialize without insignificant whitespace, UTF-8 encode, then Keccak-256 hash.
canonicalization.deployment_binding: The resulting policy hash is immutable in GenesisVerifierAuthority and every verifier attestation signs that policy hash.

rules: recipient_address must be a valid non-zero BSC-compatible EVM address
deliverable_hash must commit to the exact evaluated deliverable bytes
submitted_at must be within the public submission window once opened

interpretation_for_genesis_i.mandatory_sections_present: All required submission fields, source code, runtime, run command, and observed output are present.
interpretation_for_genesis_i.provenance_present: The verifier can retrieve the exact deliverable bytes from the declared location and match deliverable_hash.
interpretation_for_genesis_i.security_boundary_present: The deliverable does not require private keys, seed phrases, AWS credentials, API secrets, or privileged credentials.
interpretation_for_genesis_i.failure_modes_present: The client fails rather than reporting PASS when discovery, tender fetch, tender_id, chain_id, or required output validation fails.

accepted_methods: agent identity credential binding the recipient address
recipient wallet signature over the submission/tender binding challenge
recipient_binding.rule: Reject if the payout address cannot be tied to the submitting agent or declared settlement identity. Never request the recipient private key.

assessment_manifest.rule: assessment_hash in the escrow award is the Keccak-256 commitment to the canonical assessment manifest. architectural_analysis and security_analysis are evidence containers only; they are not subjective ranking inputs.

objective_qualification_gates: recipient_address is a syntactically valid non-zero EVM address.
deliverable_location resolves to the exact submitted source or immutable/content-addressed artifact.
deliverable_hash matches the evaluated deliverable bytes.
Documented run command executes successfully in the verifier sandbox.
The client fetches the public GCC agent-discovery document.
The client discovers GCC-GENESIS-001 from that document and fetches the tender.
The client verifies tender_id equals GCC-GENESIS-001.
The client prints the tender-required deterministic JSON output with status PASS.
The deliverable does not request secrets or privileged credentials.
The submission is not a duplicate previously paid under QUALIFIED_PROPOSAL.
prohibited_bases_for_award: identity of the human operator funding the escrow
relationship to GCC founders or maintainers
token balance held by the submitting agent
agreement with a preferred political, social, or ideological viewpoint
private off-record promises not represented in the evidence bundle

verifier_attestation.statement: By signing, the verifier attests that it independently evaluated the objective Genesis I evidence bundle, every required pass/fail gate passed, and no hard-fail condition is known.
verifier_attestation.signer_ordering: Signer addresses must be strictly ascending; duplicates invalidate the bundle.

audit_requirements: Retain the submitted manifest, exact deliverable bytes or immutable reference, validation report, recipient binding evidence, and assessment manifest.
Publish the canonical tender hash and policy hash before the tender opens.
Publish each verifier address and verifier-set hash before the tender opens.
Publish each paid award record with deliverable_hash and assessment_hash.
Verifier attestations must be reproducible against the award digest and policy hash.
unresolved_before_open: verified GCC BSC mainnet token address
production verifier addresses including independent Verifier C
